diagnosis: The failure occurs because `grind` splits the special `old(x)` application only after simplification has run, leaving the replacement-variable membership unsimplified. Explicitly splitting `substOld`’s match and equality test, then simplifying again, resolves those branches before `grind` handles the remaining propositional subset cases.
proof_body:
by
  induction post <;>
    simp_all [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
      Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.Subset] <;>
    try split <;>
    try split <;>
    simp_all [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] <;>
    grind
